title: Mahlon Howard
gallery_text: I’ve been photographing architecture and cities throughout my travels for several years - I've been to 29 countries. I took this photo last month in Zurich, Switzerland, and it's an example of how I’ve been using photography to document the places I visit and explore representation through visual storytelling.

answers.interest: I’m interested in finding new ways to use computation as part of my design process. I want to become more comfortable experimenting with these tools and using them to explore ideas and test possibilities that aren't commonly used in traditional design methods.
answers.suggestions: I’m still exploring what I’d like to do with the course, so I’d be interested in seeing a range of examples and tutorials that demonstrate different ways to apply these tools. I’d like to learn through exercises and experiments before committing to a larger project.
